content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://rdpri.andamannicobar.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Young Professional post is 19th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduate Degree or PG Diploma in relevant disciplines. Additionally, 0-2 years of post-qualification experience from reputed academic and training institutes is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional post is 30 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 32,500.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Andaman & Nicobar Administration Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with required documents via post before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the creation of a Merit List, followed by a Personal Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Young Professional post in the Andaman & Nicobar Administration Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration, which is https://rdpri.andamannicobar.gov.in.
